## Changes

- Select the smallest TorBox-confirmed cached 720p stream for thumbnail generation; if none exists, select the smallest confirmed cached 1080p stream.
- Keep the existing availability-aware fallback when neither cached resolution is available. Provider labels and TorBox URLs are no longer treated as verified cache hits.
- Reuse cache status already obtained during source discovery. No additional TorBox request is made by thumbnail selection, and no cache check is made without a configured TorBox integration.

## Verification And Limitations

The full Android unit suite and release lint passed locally. Physical TV playback and live TorBox responses remain to be verified on-device.
